description: Na₂VF₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.76 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are four shorter (1.91 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) V-F bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.01 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted FNa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₃V tetrahedra, corners with seven FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramid. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na and two V atoms to form distorted FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent FNa₃V tetrahedra, corners with five FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃V tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃V trigonal pyramid. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted FNa₃V trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent FNa₃V tetrahedra, corners with six FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramid. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom.
